Tests setting and removing breakpoints on class fields and computed property names.
--- class Y single breakpoints ---
class Y {
  x = #1;
  y = 2;

x = [B0]1;
  y = 2;
  z = 3
x = 1;
  y = 2;
  z = 3
  x = 1;
  y = #2;
  z = 3;

x = 1;
  y = [B0]2;
  z = 3
x = 1;
  y = 2;
  z = 3
  y = 2;
  z = #3;
}

x = 1;
  y = 2;
  z = [B0]3
x = 1;
  y = 2;
  z = 3
--- class Y breakpoint pairs ---
class Y {
  x = #1;
  y = 2;

  x = 1;
  y = #2;
  z = 3;

x = [B0]1;
  y = [B1]2;
  z = 3
x = 1;
  y = [B0]2;
  z = 3
x = 1;
  y = 2;
  z = 3
class Y {
  x = #1;
  y = 2;

  y = 2;
  z = #3;
}

x = [B0]1;
  y = 2;
  z = [B1]3
x = 1;
  y = 2;
  z = [B0]3
x = 1;
  y = 2;
  z = 3
  x = 1;
  y = #2;
  z = 3;

  y = 2;
  z = #3;
}

x = 1;
  y = [B0]2;
  z = [B1]3
x = 1;
  y = 2;
  z = [B0]3
x = 1;
  y = 2;
  z = 3
--- top-level class X with computed property ---
class X {
  [#foo()] = 1;
  baz = foo();

[foo()] = 1;
  baz = foo()
  [foo()] = 1;
  baz = #foo();
}

[foo()] = 1;
  baz = [B0]foo()
--- function t() enclosing class X ---
  class X {
    [#foo()] = 1;
    [bar] = 2;

    baz = foo();
